rooms.name: Cellar
rooms.blurb: A single giant rat among the barrels.

rooms.name: Sewer
rooms.blurb: A swarm of giant rats in a sewer junction.

rooms.name: Wolf's lair
rooms.blurb: A lone wolf in a cave mouth.

rooms.name: Gatehouse
rooms.blurb: Goblins and an archer behind two pillars.

rooms.name: Kennels
rooms.blurb: A wolf pack across a floor of broken straw and rubble.

rooms.name: Trapped corridor
rooms.blurb: Two sarnaks at the end of a narrow corridor sown with fire and pit traps.

rooms.name: Troll den
rooms.blurb: A cave troll among rubble and boulders.

rooms.name: Cistern
rooms.blurb: Frogloks beyond a flooded channel with one walkway across.

rooms.name: Kobold warren
rooms.blurb: Kobold spearmen in a low warren, a pit trap at the mouth.

rooms.name: Crypt
rooms.blurb: Skeletons among pillars, a pool of darkness between.

rooms.name: Chieftain's hall
rooms.blurb: The troll chieftain in a pillared hall with braziers of coals.

rooms.name: Hall of whispers
rooms.blurb: A spectre among pools of darkness. Only spells and magic weapons touch it.

rooms.name: Black chapel
rooms.blurb: The death knight alone among the pillars of his chapel.

attrition.label: Attrition
attrition.blurb: One party through all eight rooms; wounds carry on, with a breather between rooms and a camp (a long rest) after rooms 4, 8, 11. The run ends at the first room the party can't win.

reset.label: Reset
reset.blurb: A fresh, full-strength party for every room, the dead restored. Every room is fought in every run; deaths are recorded room by room.
